# Clínica Universidad de Navarra (CUN)

> > Leading Spanish university hospital offering specialized medical care, advanced treatments, and clinical research across oncology, orthopedics, and multiple medical specialties in Madrid, Pamplona, and Navarre.

Clínica Universidad de Navarra (CUN) is a prestigious academic medical center affiliated with the University of Navarra, featuring a dedicated Cancer Center and internationally recognized specialists. The institution combines clinical excellence with cutting-edge research, including clinical trials and advanced diagnostic technologies like PET imaging and theranostics.

## Key Topics

- Clínica Universidad de Navarra (CUN)

## Medical Treatments & Procedures

- [Lumbar Disc Herniation: what it is, symptoms and treatment](https://www.cun.es/en/diseases-treatments/diseases/lumbar-disc-herniation): Lumbar disc herniation symptoms, diagnosis, and conservative treatment options
- [Knee Arthroscopy](https://www.cun.es/en/diseases-treatments/treatments/knee-arthroscopy): Knee arthroscopy minimally invasive treatment for rapid recovery at CUN
- [Types of anesthesia](https://www.cun.es/en/diseases-treatments/treatments/types-anesthesia): Anesthesia types and patient safety for surgical procedures at CUN
- [Tooth abscess: Treatment](https://www.cun.es/en/diseases-treatments/diseases/dental-abscess): Tooth abscess treatment, prevention, and dental care solutions at CUN

## Clinical Research & Trials

- [Amivantamab and mFOLFOX6 or FOLFIRI clinical trial for colorectal cancer](https://www.cun.es/en/research/clinical-trials/amivantamab-colorectal-cancer): Phase 3 trial: Amivantamab + chemotherapy for metastatic colorectal cancer
